sloka: एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु कौसल्या चिरकालाभिकाङ्क्षितम् ।हर्ष्बाष्पकलं वाक्यमिदं राम मभाषत ॥२-४-३८॥
transliteration: etacchrutvā tu kausalyā cirakālābhikāṅkṣitam ।harṣbāṣpakalaṁ vākyamidaṁ rāma mabhāṣata ॥2-4-38॥

translations.english: "Surely it was under an auspicious constellation that I bore you, dear son, since by your virtues you have won your father Dasaratha."
